request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the helmet dome: it becomes blackened rusted iron, a very dark warm charcoal grey with two small rust-brown dents and no shine, clearly darker than the sword, and the green moss patch on it is removed. Keep the bronze rim, the black crest, the skull, the violet eyes, the bones, the shield, the sword, the loincloth with its violet trim, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
